title: 3.3.17 Lab: Read and Update a Nested Array
description: Read and reassign values in a nested array with double-index syntax, then sum every cell with a nested loop. Auto-graded.

steps.title: Create a nested array
steps.instructions: Create a variable called grid and assign it a 2x2 (or larger) nested array of numbers.

steps.title: Log one inner value
steps.instructions: Use double-index syntax like grid[r][c] to console.log one specific inner value.

steps.title: Update one inner value
steps.instructions: Reassign one inner value using grid[r][c] = ... .

steps.title: Sum every number
steps.instructions: Use a nested loop (outer over rows, inner over cells) to add up every number in the grid, then console.log the total.

requirements.title: double-index access present
requirements.description: Code reads or writes with two indexes

requirements.title: nested for loops present
requirements.description: Code contains at least two for loops
